entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In fact, we were busier than ever n..."
entries.dialogueText: In fact, we were busier than ever now that Monica's work with the Commission on the Status of Women was in full swing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She spent most days of the week mee..."
entries.dialogueText: She spent most days of the week meeting with Ciara or members of the Assembly, discussing how to implement the new laws I had passed. I often had to pitch in with chores or help Deana with her homework myself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A reversal of the usual husband-and..."
entries.dialogueText: A reversal of the usual husband-and-wife roles, to be sure. Lileas Graf would be furious if she knew.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was dozing on the couch after yet..."
entries.dialogueText: I was dozing on the couch after yet another frozen TV dinner when I heard the key turn in the lock. Monica stumbled into the hall.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Honey, I'm home!""
entries.dialogueText: "Honey, I'm home!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was late at night when I exited..."
entries.dialogueText: It was late at night when I exited Serge's car, walked through the gates of the presidential complex and unlocked my front door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica and I weren't speaking much..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica and I weren't speaking much at all these days. I'd been spending more and more time in the office, just to avoid the chilly atmosphere that awaited me at home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The lights in the kitchen were stil..."
entries.dialogueText: The lights in the kitchen were still on. I walked in to find Monica sitting alone at the table, pouring the dregs of a bottle of Kebij into her glass.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Well, if it isn't the savior of So..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if it isn't the savior of Sordish women! Our knight in shining armor!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're drunk.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're drunk."
entries.menuText: "You're drunk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't start with me. I'm not in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't start with me. I'm not in the mood."
entries.menuText: "Don't start with me. I'm not in the mood."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""At your service, ma'am.""
entries.dialogueText: "At your service, ma'am."
entries.menuText: "At your service, ma'am."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I was being sarcastic, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "I was being sarcastic, Anton."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Very perceptive, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very perceptive, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think I know what this is about.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think I know what this is about."
entries.menuText: "I think I know what this is about."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""*You're* not in the mood?""
entries.dialogueText: "*You're* not in the mood?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Ciara called and told me what happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara called and told me what happened with her women's rights bill. Because she knew I'd want to know."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Ciara's been filling me in on her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara's been filling me in on her commission's progress. Apparently Lotherberg Group lobbyists have convinced some Assembly members to pushback against the equal pay section of the women's rights decree."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This would never have happened if..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would never have happened if you'd allowed me to get involved."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's not true.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's not true."
entries.menuText: "That's not true."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ciara's been doing her best.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara's been doing her best."
entries.menuText: "Ciara's been doing her best."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Ciara's too radical and you know i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara's too radical and you know it. Those old men needed a skirt-wearing housewife like me to convince them women's rights aren't just for spinsters and lesbians."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica hiccuped."
entries.dialogueText: Monica hiccuped.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This was my big chance. The one th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was my big chance. The one thing I'd wanted to do since before I even met you. And you -- Anton Rayne -- you ruined it!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great news, isn't it? We won!""
entries.dialogueText: "Great news, isn't it? We won!"
entries.menuText: "Great news, isn't it? We won!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So... you're drinking to celebrate?""
entries.dialogueText: "So... you're drinking to celebrate?"
entries.menuText: "So... you're drinking to celebrate?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""*You* won. While forcing your own..."
entries.dialogueText: "*You* won. While forcing your own wife to the sidelines. Congratulations."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Yes, I'm celebrating being a mere..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm celebrating being a mere footnote in your great victory."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed == true || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed == true ||BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've advanced the status of women..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've advanced the status of women further than any president in Sordish history. Be grateful."
entries.menuText: "I've advanced the status of women further than any president in Sordish history. Be grateful."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I did this for you, Monica. I thou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did this for you, Monica. I thought you'd be happy."
entries.menuText: "I did this for you, Monica. I thought you'd be happy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All I wanted to do was protect you..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I wanted to do was protect you. You've seen what this job has done to me these past three years."
entries.menuText: "All I wanted to do was protect you. You've seen what this job has done to me these past three years."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're a First Lady, not a politic..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a First Lady, not a politician. You knew that going in."
entries.menuText: "You're a First Lady, not a politician. You knew that going in."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Other women would kill to be marri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Other women would kill to be married to the President of Sordland. Can't you just shut up and be satisfied?"
entries.menuText: "Other women would kill to be married to the President of Sordland. Can't you just shut up and be satisfied?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh."
entries.menuText: "Oh."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let me explain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me explain."
entries.menuText: "Let me explain."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Vetoed, Anton? It's not enough to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vetoed, Anton? It's not enough to deny your wife opportunities -- you've got to screw over every women in Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, have I ever.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, have I ever."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Then you don't know me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you don't know me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica sighed deeply."
entries.dialogueText: Monica sighed deeply.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I am grateful. But I can't be happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful. But I can't be happy about it."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You really don't know me, do you?""
entries.dialogueText: "You really don't know me, do you?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I thought we'd be a team. How stup..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought we'd be a team. How stupid of me."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I don't think I can do this anymor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think I can do this anymore. I'm calling Evelyn's divorce attorney."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Wait. Please. Let's talk about thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Please. Let's talk about this."
entries.menuText: "Wait. Please. Let's talk about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can't divorce me! At least not..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't divorce me! At least not until next year."
entries.menuText: "You can't divorce me! At least not until next year."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You wouldn't dare.""
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't dare."
entries.menuText: "You wouldn't dare."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""What is there to talk about? It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is there to talk about? It's been over since that day you hit me on the balcony."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That's what you care about? Your c..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what you care about? Your chances of getting re-elected?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This is one thing you can't forbid..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is one thing you can't forbid me from doing."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""What are you going to do? Hit me a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you going to do? Hit me again?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I reached into my briefcase and pul..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached into my briefcase and pulled out the photo of us I had taken from my old office.
entries.menuText: Show Monica the framed photo you took from your old office.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look how happy we are here. We lov..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look how happy we are here. We loved each other once. We can still fix this."
entries.menuText: "Look how happy we are here. We loved each other once. We can still fix this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look how determined we are here. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look how determined we are here. If you divorce me now, we risk losing everything we fought so hard for."
entries.menuText: "Look how determined we are here. If you divorce me now, we risk losing everything we fought so hard for."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It's too late for talking.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for talking."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I-- I don't know, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I don't know, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked at it. Tears began to..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked at it. Tears began to form in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If you leave me now, my public opi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you leave me now, my public opinion might not survive the blow. I could lose the election, Monica."
entries.menuText: "If you leave me now, my public opinion might not survive the blow. I could lose the election, Monica."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll pay you to stay. At least unt..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll pay you to stay. At least until after the election."
entries.menuText: "I'll pay you to stay. At least until after the election."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Bribery? You're going to treat me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bribery? You're going to treat me like one of your crooked politician pals?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hey, you're the one who said you w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, you're the one who said you wanted to be involved in politics."
entries.menuText: "Hey, you're the one who said you wanted to be involved in politics."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Think about the kids. You'll be ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about the kids. You'll be able to provide for them without having to ask me for a cent."
entries.menuText: "Think about the kids. You'll be able to provide for them without having to ask me for a cent."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights == true || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed == true || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The people of Sordland love you mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Sordland love you more than me, after all."
entries.menuText: "The people of Sordland love you more than me, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And then whatever progress Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then whatever progress Sordland has made for women's rights will be lost as well."
entries.menuText: "And then whatever progress Sordland has made for women's rights will be lost as well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And then whatever progress I've ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then whatever progress I've managed to make for this country will be lost as well."
entries.menuText: "And then whatever progress I've managed to make for this country will be lost as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica cradled her head in her hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica cradled her head in her hands.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""We will remain married in name alo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will remain married in name alone. You'll sleep in the guesthouse and interact with Deana and myself only when necessary. The day after the election, I'm filing for divorce."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can't control whether I see De..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't control whether I see Deana! She's my daughter, too."
entries.menuText: "You can't control whether I see Deana! She's my daughter, too."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can accept those conditions.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can accept those conditions."
entries.menuText: "I can accept those conditions."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All right. I'll hold off on talkin..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'll hold off on talking to the lawyer. At least until after you're re-elected."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Monica.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Monica."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Monica."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That gives me more time to figure..."
entries.dialogueText: "That gives me more time to figure out how I can win you back."
entries.menuText: "That gives me more time to figure out how I can win you back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gave me the faintest of nods..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gave me the faintest of nods.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I couldn't care less about your pu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't care less about your public opinion."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I couldn't care less about your so..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't care less about your so-called progress. You failed on the issue that matters most to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica cradled her head in her hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica cradled her head in her hands.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm calling the lawyer tomorrow. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm calling the lawyer tomorrow. We can wait a few weeks to tell Deana."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I will not let you insult me like..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let you insult me like this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pushed her chair roughly away."
entries.dialogueText: She pushed her chair roughly away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's expression softened slight..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's expression softened slightly.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I won't need to ask for a cent bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't need to ask for a cent because I'm taking everything. You hear me, Anton? Everything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica clenched her jaw."
entries.dialogueText: Monica clenched her jaw.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If you think you're going to keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think you're going to keep custody of her, you're goddamn mistaken."
entries.menuText: "If you think you're going to keep custody of her, you're goddamn mistaken."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to make sure you wind up..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to make sure you wind up with nothing."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to make sure you wind up with nothing."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights == true || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed == true || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Turn08_Decree_WomensRights"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Signed"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But I do care about the progress y..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I do care about the progress you've made towards women's equality. Even if you've blocked me from taking part in it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Monica. Look at this photograph.""
entries.dialogueText: "Monica. Look at this photograph."
entries.menuText: "Monica. Look at this photograph."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Then maybe you care about money?""
entries.dialogueText: "Then maybe you care about money?"
entries.menuText: "Then maybe you care about money?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I reached into my briefcase and pul..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached into my briefcase and pulled out the photo of us I had taken from my old office.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. I'll respect your wishes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I'll respect your wishes."
entries.menuText: "Fine. I'll respect your wishes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica glared at me."
entries.dialogueText: Monica glared at me.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I don't want her around you. Not t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want her around you. Not the way you are now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked at me for a long mome..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked at me for a long moment.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I wish it hadn't come to this, Ant..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish it hadn't come to this, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's expression hardened."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's expression hardened.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm sorry, Anton. It's too late.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Anton. It's too late."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'd rather be penniless than spend..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather be penniless than spend another moment married to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up her empty glass and thr..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up her empty glass and threw it to the ground. Shards flew everywhere.
entries.menuText: Pick up her glass and smash it on the ground.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Screw you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Screw you."
entries.menuText: "Screw you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sorry. I've been a horrible hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. I've been a horrible husband and father."
entries.menuText: "I'm sorry. I've been a horrible husband and father."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""See you in court.""
entries.dialogueText: "See you in court."
entries.menuText: "See you in court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Me, neither.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me, neither."
entries.menuText: "Me, neither."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right away, I heard the sound of fo..."
entries.dialogueText: Right away, I heard the sound of footsteps running towards the kitchen. Deana burst in and threw herself between me and Monica.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""Papa, don't hurt her! Please!""
entries.dialogueText: "Papa, don't hurt her! Please!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Deana. Pack a bag. We're staying a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Deana. Pack a bag. We're staying at a hotel tonight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With one last furious look at me, M..."
entries.dialogueText: With one last furious look at me, Monica ushered Deana upstairs. I'd lost both of them. Possibly forever.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sighed, grabbed a broom and start..."
entries.dialogueText: I sighed, grabbed a broom and started sweeping up the broken glass on the floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's lips formed a thin line."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's lips formed a thin line.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm taking Deana to a hotel tonigh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm taking Deana to a hotel tonight. I don't want to see you when I get back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With one last furious look at me, M..."
entries.dialogueText: With one last furious look at me, Monica marched upstairs to get Deana.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I-- I'm taking Deana to a hotel to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I'm taking Deana to a hotel tonight. I think it's for the best that we don't see each other for a while."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "After they left, I rang up Orso Haw..."
entries.dialogueText: After they left, I rang up Orso Hawker. I may have lost my wife, but I was going to keep my daughter.
entries.menuText: Call Orso Hawker to ensure you keep custody of Deana.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success == true && BaseGame.ChiefJustice_OrsoHawker == true && BaseGame.YoungSords_Kill_OrsoHawker == false)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.ChiefJustice_OrsoHawker"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.YoungSords_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == false) == false

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "After they left, I sat there in the..."
entries.dialogueText: After they left, I sat there in the kitchen for a long time, replaying my 20-year marriage over and over in my head.
entries.menuText: Do nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After they left, I sat there in the..."
entries.dialogueText: After they left, I sat there in the kitchen for a long time, replaying my 20-year marriage over and over in my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With one last regretful look at me,..."
entries.dialogueText: With one last regretful look at me, Monica trudged upstairs to get Deana.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Can-- can you find somewhere else..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can-- can you find somewhere else to sleep tonight? I need to be alone for a little while."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded numbly. A short time later..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded numbly. A short time later, bag in hand, I called Serge and asked him to take me to the closest hotel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we were driving away, I took a l..."
entries.dialogueText: As we were driving away, I took a look back at the house where my wife and daughter were sleeping. I hoped I hadn't lost them forever.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Where were you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where were you?"
entries.menuText: "Where were you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kissed her. Her breath smelled li..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed her. Her breath smelled like gin.
entries.menuText: Kiss her.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you know how late it is?""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you know how late it is?"
entries.menuText: "Don't you know how late it is?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I was just having a few drinks wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just having a few drinks with Ciara."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After weeks of late nights, Monica,..."
entries.dialogueText: After weeks of late nights, Monica, Ciara and the women's rights commission had succeeded in getting their bill through the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was as comprehensive as they cou..."
entries.dialogueText: It was as comprehensive as they could have hoped for. I was looking forward to celebrating with my wife.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But it had been hours since I'd got..."
entries.dialogueText: But it had been hours since I'd gotten home, and she still wasn't there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After weeks of late nights, Monica,..."
entries.dialogueText: After weeks of late nights, Monica, Ciara and the women's rights commission had succeeded in getting their bill through the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The result wasn't as comprehensive..."
entries.dialogueText: The result wasn't as comprehensive as they'd hoped for, but it was a good start. I was looking forward to celebrating with my wife.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After weeks of late nights, Monica,..."
entries.dialogueText: After weeks of late nights, Monica, Ciara and the women's rights commission had succeeded in presenting their bill before the Assembly -- only for it to fail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left work early, expecting my wif..."
entries.dialogueText: I left work early, expecting my wife would be in need of comfort.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After weeks of late nights, Monica,..."
entries.dialogueText: After weeks of late nights, Monica, Ciara and the women's rights commission had succeeded in getting their bill through the Assembly -- only for me to veto it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left work early in order to expla..."
entries.dialogueText: I left work early in order to explain myself to my wife.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""The Lotherberg lobbyists are alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lotherberg lobbyists are already trying to negotiate over our equal pay law. But we showed those pricks who's boss!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hiccuped."
entries.dialogueText: She hiccuped.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I can't believe we did it! Anton,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe we did it! Anton, this is such amazing news."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm actually amazed any version of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm actually amazed any version of our bill passed, given how stacked the Assembly was against us. But of course she wants to keep pushing for more."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""We were so close to winning, Anton..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were so close to winning, Anton. Those goddamn Assembly pricks ruined it all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You could've invited me to the cel..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could've invited me to the celebrations."
entries.menuText: "You could've invited me to the celebrations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She collapsed onto the couch and bu..."
entries.dialogueText: She collapsed onto the couch and buried her head in her hands.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So you decided to get juiced.""
entries.dialogueText: "So you decided to get juiced."
entries.menuText: "So you decided to get juiced."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You could've invited me to the com..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could've invited me to the commiseration session."
entries.menuText: "You could've invited me to the commiseration session."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""We had to get drunk after what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had to get drunk after what you did to our bill. Vetoed, Anton? What on Earth were you thinking?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She collapsed onto the couch and bu..."
entries.dialogueText: She collapsed onto the couch and buried her head in her hands.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This was my big chance. The one th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was my big chance. The one thing I'd wanted to do since before I even met you. And you -- Anton Rayne -- you ruined it!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't think this bill was good..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't think this bill was good enough. We'll have another chance next year."
entries.menuText: "I didn't think this bill was good enough. We'll have another chance next year."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry, I changed my mind. It would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, I changed my mind. It would be too unpopular of a decision."
entries.menuText: "Sorry, I changed my mind. It would be too unpopular of a decision."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry, I changed my mind. You ladi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, I changed my mind. You ladies were asking for too much, too quickly."
entries.menuText: "Sorry, I changed my mind. You ladies were asking for too much, too quickly."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Well, yes. Isn't it what a man wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, yes. Isn't it what a man would do?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, you would've found it boring...."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you would've found it boring. And somebody had to look after Deana."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My God. I'm starting to see what I..."
entries.dialogueText: "My God. I'm starting to see what I put you through for all those years."
entries.menuText: "My God. I'm starting to see what I put you through for all those years."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I believe you're turning into a po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe you're turning into a politician, Mrs. Rayne."
entries.menuText: "I believe you're turning into a politician, Mrs. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not sure I like this side of y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure I like this side of you."
entries.menuText: "I'm not sure I like this side of you."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Get used to it, baby.""
entries.dialogueText: "Get used to it, baby."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Seriously, Anton -- this is what I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seriously, Anton -- this is what I want to do. I've never felt so alive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm happy if you're happy.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy if you're happy."
entries.menuText: "I'm happy if you're happy."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pulled her into a hug, and she wr..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled her into a hug, and she wrapped her arms around me tightly.
entries.menuText: Hug her.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm glad something good came out o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad something good came out of these hellish years."
entries.menuText: "I'm glad something good came out of these hellish years."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I opened my briefcase and pulled ou..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened my briefcase and pulled out the photograph I'd taken from my old office on that fateful night with Petr.
entries.menuText: Show her the framed photo you took from your old office.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, wow. Look at us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, wow. Look at us."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Don't you worry. The best is yet t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you worry. The best is yet to come."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who would have thought we would wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who would have thought we would wind up as Sordland's most powerful couple?"
entries.menuText: "Who would have thought we would wind up as Sordland's most powerful couple?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We were so young. We had no idea w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were so young. We had no idea what was in store."
entries.menuText: "We were so young. We had no idea what was in store."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm still as madly in love with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still as madly in love with you as I was the day that photo was taken."
entries.menuText: "I'm still as madly in love with you as I was the day that photo was taken."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Now all we have to do is make sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now all we have to do is make sure you stay in office."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica wrapped her arms around me."
entries.dialogueText: Monica wrapped her arms around me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You let me worry about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You let me worry about that."
entries.menuText: "You let me worry about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica smiled, took my hand and wor..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica smiled, took my hand and wordlessly led me upstairs to the bedroom.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm not going to stop until we get..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to stop until we get what we're asking for. True equality for all women in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With you by my side, how can I los..."
entries.dialogueText: "With you by my side, how can I lose?"
entries.menuText: "With you by my side, how can I lose?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And that's where the real politics..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that's where the real politics begins."
entries.menuText: "And that's where the real politics begins."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, I always had an idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I always had an idea."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stayed curled up on the couch ti..."
entries.dialogueText: We stayed curled up on the couch till late, talking and reminiscing about old times, until Monica took my hand and wordlessly led me upstairs to the bedroom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stayed curled up on the couch, t..."
entries.dialogueText: We stayed curled up on the couch, talking about my re-election strategy and the next steps with the women's rights bill, until Monica took my hand and wordlessly led me upstairs to the bedroom.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Why didn't you talk to me first? H..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why didn't you talk to me first? Haven't you learned anything this entire time?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't get the chance. I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't get the chance. I'm sorry."
entries.menuText: "I didn't get the chance. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You were lucky I let you get invol..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were lucky I let you get involved at all."
entries.menuText: "You were lucky I let you get involved at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's eyes flashed."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's eyes flashed.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Well, we're not going to stop figh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we're not going to stop fighting for this. With or without you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know. That's why I married you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. That's why I married you."
entries.menuText: "I know. That's why I married you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you know a lost cause when y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you know a lost cause when you see one?"
entries.menuText: "Don't you know a lost cause when you see one?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica scowled and looked straight..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica scowled and looked straight at me.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""In this case, I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "In this case, I do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica smiled wearily."
entries.dialogueText: Monica smiled wearily.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm not really in the mood to keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not really in the mood to keep talking. It's time for bed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without another word, she headed up..."
entries.dialogueText: Without another word, she headed up the stairs, leaving me alone with my thoughts again.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This would never have happened if..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would never have happened if you'd supported her."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This would never have happened if..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would never have happened if you'd supported us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It just wasn't the right time.""
entries.dialogueText: "It just wasn't the right time."
entries.menuText: "It just wasn't the right time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was just too risky.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was just too risky."
entries.menuText: "It was just too risky."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You ladies were asking for too muc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You ladies were asking for too much, too quickly."
entries.menuText: "You ladies were asking for too much, too quickly."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That's bullshit.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's bullshit."

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""Papa, don't hurt her again! Please!""
entries.dialogueText: "Papa, don't hurt her again! Please!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All things must come to an end."
entries.dialogueText: All things must come to an end.

entries.dialogueText: All things must come to an end.

entries.title: Narrator: "It had been a while since Petr disa..."
entries.dialogueText: It had been a while since Petr disappeared from our lives. I still found myself thinking of jokes he'd find funny or wanting to tell him what had happened at my last meeting. But the grief was beginning to fade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica visited Evelyn often at firs..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica visited Evelyn often at first, helping her process her mixed emotions. Eventually, Evelyn sold Petr's villa in Erlory and used the proceeds to travel the world, something she'd always wanted to do when she and Petr were together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For myself and Monica, though, life..."
entries.dialogueText: For myself and Monica, though, life in the capitol had to go on. And it did.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: I leaned in to kiss her, but she pushed me away. I smelled gin on her breath.
entries.menuText: Kiss her.

entries.dialogueText: Monica scowled.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come on, Monica. I didn't even car..."

entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Monica. You know I've always cared about this. I wouldn't leave you out of it unless there was a good reason."

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""How would I know? I wasn't there.""
entries.dialogueText: "How would I know? I wasn't there."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can. I do. I hereby forbid you f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can. I do. I hereby forbid you from divorcing me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You will not divorce me, Monica. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not divorce me, Monica. I forbid it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gaped at me disbelievingly."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gaped at me disbelievingly.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""How can you even say that to me?""
entries.dialogueText: "How can you even say that to me?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Who the hell are you, Anton Rayne?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who the hell are you, Anton Rayne?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm the same man I've always been...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm the same man I've always been. You just didn't want to see it because you were too focused on your own ambitions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm a man whose enemies have a hab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm a man whose enemies have a habit of... disappearing."

entries.title: Player_Italic: "I reached into my briefcase and pul..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached into my briefcase and pulled out the old photo of the two of us.
entries.menuText: Show her the photograph you took from your old office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked at it. Tears began to..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked at it. Tears began to form in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope you can find someone else w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you can find someone else who makes you as happy as you look here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Damn. We used to be hot stuff.""
entries.dialogueText: "Damn. We used to be hot stuff."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: Monica shook her head.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I-- I'm taking Deana to a hotel to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I'm taking Deana to a hotel tonight. I think it's for the best that we don't see each other for a while."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With one last regretful look at me,..."
entries.dialogueText: With one last regretful look at me, Monica trudged upstairs to get Deana.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Keep it. To remember me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Keep it. To remember me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica laughed ruefully."
entries.dialogueText: Monica laughed ruefully.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, I'll never forget you, Anton...."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I'll never forget you, Anton. For better or worse."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Now you're interested in being a g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now you're interested in being a good father? For heaven's sake, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica laughed ruefully."
entries.dialogueText: Monica laughed ruefully.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Look at what politics did to us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Look at what politics did to us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gave me a rueful look."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gave me a rueful look.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Love wasn't the reason I looked so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Love wasn't the reason I looked so happy back then. It was hope."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""No. God, no! It's too late.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. God, no! It's too late."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Maybe everyone else lets you talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe everyone else lets you talk to them this way. But I will not."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm the most powerful man in Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm the most powerful man in Sordland. Disobey me at your own risk."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: She swallowed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: She swallowed.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That kind of intimidation might wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "That kind of intimidation might work on your political opponents. But not me."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""No, you've changed. You let your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you've changed. You let your power get to your head. Just like Soll."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You might be right. But it's all c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might be right. But it's all crystal clear now."
